findings.title: Missing essential organizational attributes: direct contact details (email or telephone)
findings.evidence: A comprehensive scan across 10 crawled pages revealed no verifiable information for: direct contact details (email or telephone). Absence of these fundamental attributes degrades entity trust and prevents AI systems from corroborating corporate legitimacy.

suggested_action.summary: Publish unambiguous details for direct contact details (email or telephone) in a standard Contact or About page and in Schema.org structured metadata.

findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD Schema.org 'Organization' or 'LocalBusiness' definition was found on 'https://fastapi.tiangolo.com' or secondary pages. Structured entity metadata enables search engines and AI systems to ground the entity without heuristic guessing.

suggested_action.summary: Implement JSON-LD Schema.org 'Organization' or 'Corporation' on the homepage with fields: @context, @type, name, url, logo, description, and sameAs links.

findings.title: Broken heading hierarchy skips intermediate heading levels
findings.evidence: Page 'https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/first-steps/' contains illogical heading level skips: [H1->H3]. Skipping heading levels impairs accessibility tree construction and content parsing.

suggested_action.summary: Restructure headings sequentially (H1 followed by H2, then H3) without skipping levels to maintain an intuitive document outline.

findings.title: Navigation links use vague, non-descriptive anchor text
findings.evidence: Page at 'https://fastapi.tiangolo.com' contains 2 vague or empty link anchor texts: ['[Empty Anchor]', '[Empty Anchor]']. Non-descriptive anchors hinder screen readers and search agent comprehension.

suggested_action.summary: Replace generic anchor texts like 'click here' or 'read more' with descriptive labels indicating the destination content (e.g., 'View Enterprise Pricing Plans').

findings.title: Insufficient organization disambiguation and business description
findings.evidence: The website provides the entity name 'FastAPI', but fails to provide a clear, unambiguous statement of what the organization does, its industry category, and whom it serves. Detected industry: None. Description snippet: 'None...

findings.title: Dense body content lacks subheadings for scannability
findings.evidence: Page 'https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/learn/' contains 585 words of body text but lacks <h2> or <h3> subheadings. Monolithic text blocks reduce readability and structured information extraction.

suggested_action.summary: Break long content sections into subsections with descriptive <h2> and <h3> subheadings.
